notes.title: V1.1.1.1: Now Live
notes.content:
- New UI elements.
- The work is now more evenly distributed during lives for your idols.
- Fixed a scenario where you can unlock the ability to expand the office in the free play maps Tale of Two Offices, Warehouse, and Sprawling Decisions maps by saving and loading.

notes.title: V1.1.1.0: Now Live
notes.content:
- Added customisable key bindings (available under options -> *controller icon).
- Fixed exploit where pressing F2 in the manage idols screen caused girls to level up.
- You can now quickly add and subtract huge amounts of wages by holding the shift button and holding the left or right mouse button over the + or - boxes.
- Left mouse button can be mapped to progress dialogue in the custom key binding menu.
[i]Please note that in the first story level that serves as a tutorial any text prompts for progressing the text will remain referenced as 'PRESS ENTER OR SPACE' regardless of your mapping. The same will apply to other UI elements that mention shortcuts as these are also based on static values. Going back to text progression when you remap this key this replaces the instance of ENTER meaning that SPACE is still available as a backup. [/i]

notes.title: V1.1.0.8: Now Live
notes.content: - Removed the ability to duplicate newly purchased unlockable furniture if the shift key was held while placing.

notes.title: V1.1.0.7: Now Live
notes.content: - Fixed a save file corruption that can occur when the game is saved while an idol is out on a job.

notes.title: V1.1.0.6: Now Live
notes.content:
- Fixes a freeze that occurs when recording over 144 songs.
- Fans will no longer pay to meet unhappy idols.
- The chance for the illness 'Depression' to trigger now scales based on how unhappy the idol is (MOOD).

notes.title: V1.1.0.5: Now Live
notes.content:
- Security Office now costs 400KN per SQ.
- Hospital Bed now costs 800KN.
- Buffet Table now costs 500KN.
- Printer now costs 80KN.
- Wooden Crate now costs 100KN.
- Refrigerator now costs 200KN.
- Espresso Machine now costs 3000KN.
- Fixed a bug where Memento, Punching Bag, Espresso Machine, Kotatsu, and the Starnova girl portraits did not apply to idols hired after purchasing the furniture.
- Fixed a bug in Generations Mode where the same unlockable items as above lost effect after you graduate an idol.

notes.title: V1.1.0.4: Now Live
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where Stage 19 could be cleared by performing a Dome Live instead of the Stadium Live.
- Fixed the incorrect size of an idol's hitbox when they are resting in the sickbay.
- Idol Portraits now correctly state they cost 1000 KN in their description.
- Minor text changes.

notes.title: V1.1.0.3: Now Live
notes.content:
- Resolves bug where girls in sickbay disappear after a live.
- Fixes bug where tutorial loses progress if you buy a song before the instructions.
- Cafeteria clipping issues resolved.
- Added failsafe for loading saves with corrupted data.
- Adds tip about shift+right click in Stage 3.

[b]NOTE[/b]: For localisation modders, please remember to recheck the story script in Stage 3 (Nemu's Mansion) for this new line.

notes.title: V1.1.0.1: Now Live
notes.content:
- [b]NEW FEATURE[/b]! You can now leave basic training to your idol's discretion. Select an idol and press their DANCE, SING, PERSONA, or LOOK boxes inside their Idol Window to tell them to use their own discretion to level up those stats; Or click their HP bar inside the Idol Window to tell them to go on break whenever they feel like. Alternatively, press A when an idol is selected to fully leave basic training to her discretion!

[b]Note[/b]: Idols only have authority to use Tier I facilities. Your orders are still required to use the cafeteria and event room.

[b]WARNING[/b]! Each idol have their own unique behaviours in this state so your supervision is required to make sure they're not making mistakes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36748829/6d8424dfd0e79be89257f8d672b07335c81495b9.png[/img]

- Fixed crash when clicking certain hot spots while the game is loading.
- Fixes bug where Personality Training keeps resetting if the chair is too close to another sofa.
- Fixes clipping issues when Nattan is on her alpaca.
- Fixes clipping issues during fanquakes and yandere mode.
- Fixes a crash that would occur loading older saves.
- Difficulty of yandere mode now scales with difficulty level.
- Difficulty of Julie's rebellion now scales with difficulty level.
- Minor visual fixes.

notes.title: V1.086: Now Live
notes.content:
- Fixes a bug where Steam would be unable to take screenshots.
- Fixes a bug where the Idol UI window displays incorrect related stats for food activities.
